subject.title: refactor(channels): migrate googlechat, imessage, and whatsapp group policy onto the scope tree

question: Should ScopeTree become a public Plugin SDK contract before every bundled group-policy caller has migrated?
rationale: The PR expands a shipped external contract while retaining the legacy API and most bundled callers, so the permanent API and landing order require explicit owner intent.

options.title: Migrate before export
options.body: Keep ScopeTree core-internal until all bundled callers migrate, then publish the canonical contract and deprecate the old API once.

options.title: Approve staged contract
options.body: Publish now only with an explicit compatibility window, migration plan, documentation, and parity coverage for both APIs.

options.title: Consolidate landing
options.body: Pause this stacked PR and make the broader consolidated PR the sole landing candidate after it resolves the same correctness and proof blockers.

recommendation.title: Migrate before export
recommendation.body: Keep ScopeTree core-internal until all bundled callers migrate, then publish the canonical contract and deprecate the old API once.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the resolver design and all linked migration and consolidation branches.
